name: netlens
description: NetLens — a dashboard for UniFi networks. Self-hosted. Per-device and per-app traffic with time charts and sessions; Wi-Fi signal, roaming and presence per device; access point, switch and gateway health; security events; local-network traffic; WAN status. It samples your UniFi console around the clock, so history is kept beyond UniFi's own short retention (24 hours of 5-minute data, 7 days hourly). Needs a UniFi OS console (UDM, UCG, UDR, Cloud Key Gen2+) and a local API key. After installing, open the web UI: a short setup asks for your console address, the API key and a login password. Not affiliated with Ubiquiti.
